SELECT cls,
  CASE WHEN fished_date_doy<40 THEN '32-39' WHEN fished_date_doy<50 THEN '40-49' ELSE '50-60' END as bucket,
  SUM(yt) as yt, SUM(anglers) as anglers, SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) as ypa, COUNT(*) as n
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season=6 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 32 AND 60
GROUP BY cls, bucket
ORDER BY cls, bucket
